description: Displays a project-owned WPF Resource image from an application-local pack URI or a simple binding.

source.description: Required project-owned image source. Create the file before apply, then use /Assets/hero.png or pack://application:,,,/YourAssembly;component/Assets/hero.png; the reviewed project integration plan declares it as a WPF Resource. A simple binding is also supported. External, file-system, UNC, relative, and traversal URIs are rejected.
source.previewWarning: The isolated preview may not resolve a target-project resource. Verify the final built application.

automationName.description: Required accessible description of the image content.

stretch.description: How the image fills its allocated bounds.

width.description: Optional rendered width in device-independent pixels.

height.description: Optional rendered height in device-independent pixels.

maxWidth.description: Optional maximum rendered width in device-independent pixels.

maxHeight.description: Optional maximum rendered height in device-independent pixels.

margin.description: Outer WPF Thickness separating the image from adjacent content.

opacity.description: Image opacity from fully transparent to fully opaque.
